summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of the 'Book Again' client retention flow for OnCall Foot marketplace. All 14 test scenarios passed successfully, verifying the complete booking workflow from login through booking creation, including edge cases for pending and deactivated services.

backend_issues.notes: Backend testing was not required per review_request (frontend only verification). All API calls during frontend testing worked correctly.

frontend_issues.notes: Minor 404 console errors for some resources (fonts/images) observed but do not affect functionality.

passed_tests: Navigation to /bookings and Past tab interaction
Booking #49 displays both 'Leave a review' link and 'Book again' button (data-testid='book-again-link-49')
Booking detail page /bookings/49 shows 'Book again' section (data-testid='book-again-section') with button (data-testid='book-again-button')
Submit button correctly disabled until time slot is selected
Date input accepts future date (5 days ahead) and loads available slots
Time slot selection from grid (data-testid='booking-slot-grid') enables submit button
Address and city form fields accept input correctly
Booking submission succeeds and redirects to /bookings with new pending booking visible
Booking #50 (pending status) correctly does NOT show 'Book again' section
Booking #50 shows 'Cancel booking' button as expected
Booking #51 (completed, deactivated service) shows inactive service message (data-testid='book-again-service-unavailable')
Booking #51 correctly does NOT show 'Book again' button for deactivated service
Review form (ClientReviewForm) renders correctly on completed booking #49
5-star review submission works and prevents duplicate submissions
Accessibility: 'Book again' button has proper aria-label
Accessibility: 'Book again' button is keyboard focusable
